item.content:encoded:
I downvoted the fawk out of this, then opened the interview log for completionist's sake. Soon as I came across the line "I've heard of some with too many eyes, and not enough skin, others that look like they had been dead long before they exited the womb" I immediately upvoted. I hate it when that happens

Just then read comment regarding the fourth daughter, put the algorithms in my head together, and this is now one of my new favorite SCPs.

item.title: First Post
item.content:encoded:
Thought this would be a good place to start my tenure here. I agree with Locclo that the SCP description itself was iffy, but the log made it absolutely terrifying to me. I have a…strong displeasure towards the harm of children anyway, and it just…buh. It also helps that this seems like something a crazy cult would actually do in the real world.

+1, good sir.

was going to downvote until I read the log. Now I have mixed feelings.

I had the exact same reaction.

This isn't bad and I like the twist, but it has some tone and style issues. A couple notes:

The complete instructions for enacting SCP-776-B have been restricted to Document 776-109-Alpha, a Level 776-4 restricted document, although details include [DATA EXPUNGED]

Why expunge the details, when the full stuff is already restricted?

Additionally, the dialogue is somewhat weak.

No vote for now.
